info.description: Packages only. Student asks for an additional discount with proofs; admin approves by giving a promocode (new or existing), which then applies at checkout like any promocode. Student APIs are multipart for submit/resubmit. Errors: 400 {errors:{field:[msg]}}, 404, 409 (already active / already reviewed).

| `prevExamYear` | number | yes | One of that exam's years (400 otherwise). |

| `examScorecard` | file | yes | PDF / JPG / PNG, max 5 MB. Checked by content, not by name. Official scorecard / result. |

The score type is taken from the exam master (the student never picks it). Suggested %: best slab of that exam (≥ for HIGHER, ≤ for LOWER/rank, exact stage for stages), else 0.
